name: financial-control
description: Sistema de controle financeiro (client Expo + server Go + Postgres)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server
scripts.lint: npm run lint:client && npm run lint:server
scripts.format: npm run format:client && npm run format:server
scripts.security: npm run security:client && npm run security:server
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run security
